about_the_game:
Desktop Maid is a charming AI desktop companion who lives right on your screen.

Using either the Gemini API or a local model, the characters can chat with you—and sometimes, they’ll even start the conversation first. Whether you're studying, working, or just taking a break, they’re always there by your side, making your day a little more special.
Enjoy the feeling of chatting with them as if you're using a live messenger.

If you have a VRM model, it can also react to mouse input and interact freely with other windows on your desktop.
You can create and customize character presets to suit your style, and freely share your creations with others.

Key Features

  • Real-time conversations with character AI

  • Custom VRM model support

  • Smooth interaction with window elements

  • Multiple character presets supported
    (DLC available to unlock unlimited preset slots)

  • Save and load character presets anytime

Start your special day with Desktop Maid—right now, right on your desktop.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Some features require an internet connection.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Using a local model requires more resources.

short_description: Cute AI desktop maids who live with you right on your screen. Set up presets, have conversations, and share emotional moments together.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
